The '''Twentieth Army''', also known as '''Emerald Banner Command''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Headquartered at [[Tallaan]], the 20th was one of the Southern Campaign Sector Armies, and was charged with the defense of Sector 20, later known as the [[Tapani Oversector]], which contained the beginning of the major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="EGW" />

During the Clone Wars, the 20th Sector Army fought a back-and-forth war with [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces along the Rimma and the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], especially near the Separatist strongholds of [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] and [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine]]. Near the end of the war, the 20th gained the upper hand when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] pulled many of the area's assets out of the region to use in his [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|raid]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="EGW" />

When [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Declaration of a New Order|declared]] himself [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], Emerald Banner Command became part of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="EGW" /> By [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Emerald Banner Command was under the control of the newly-appointed<ref name="WW">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref> [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Octavian Grant]].<ref name="EGW" />
